# Atomic Memory

> Standardized platform layer for AI memory, pluggable at every seam.

## Get started

- [Quickstart](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/quickstart.md): Run memory locally.

## Platform

- [Architecture](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/platform/architecture.md): Open Source is a standardized platform layer for AI memory, not a monolithic service.
- [Artifact Storage](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/platform/artifact-storage.md): Artifact storage is the optional raw-byte layer behind documents and storage
- [Composition](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/platform/composition.md): Open Source has an explicit composition root, a single function, createCoreRuntime, that owns every piece of wiring between config, the Postgres pool, repositories, stores, and services.
- [Consuming core](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/platform/consuming-core.md): atomicmemory-core can be used as a network service, embedded in a Node process, or booted as a containerized release target.
- [Lessons](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/platform/lessons.md): A lesson is a recorded failure pattern that Open Source has seen for a
- [Observability](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/platform/observability.md): Every Open Source retrieval emits a structured, stable observability
- [Providers](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/platform/providers.md): Embeddings and LLM calls in Open Source are pluggable providers behind
- [Scope](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/platform/scope.md): MemoryScope is Open Source's canonical read-path contract: a single tagged
- [Stores](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/platform/stores.md): Open Source's storage layer is exposed as a family of narrow, domain-facing

## SDK

- [Errors](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/sdk/api/errors.md): Every error the SDK throws descends from AtomicMemoryError.
- [MemoryProvider contract](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/sdk/api/memory-provider.md): This is the authoring contract for anyone implementing a MemoryProvider.
- [Reference overview](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/sdk/api/overview.md): The SDK's reference documentation comes in two shapes: hand-written contract pages (here, under API Reference) and generated type / method docs produced from the SDK's source.
- [Architecture](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/sdk/concepts/architecture.md): MemoryClient is a layered dispatcher.
- [Capabilities](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/sdk/concepts/capabilities.md): Not every memory backend supports every operation.
- [Embeddings](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/sdk/concepts/embeddings.md): The SDK ships local embedding generation through @huggingface/transformers.
- [Memory providers](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/sdk/concepts/provider-model.md): The provider model is what makes MemoryClient backend-agnostic.
- [Scopes and identity](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/sdk/concepts/scopes-and-identity.md): Every SDK operation carries a scope, the partition the memory lives in.
- [Storage adapters](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/sdk/concepts/storage-adapters.md): This page describes the SDK's client-side key/value storage adapters.
- [Artifact storage](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/sdk/guides/artifact-storage.md): The SDKs expose core's artifact-storage API for applications that need to
- [Using the atomicmemory backend](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/sdk/guides/atomicmemory-backend.md): AtomicMemoryProvider is the SDK's HTTP client for atomicmemory-core.
- [Browser entry](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/sdk/guides/browser-helpers.md): The SDK ships a slim entry point for applications that run in the browser against a backend-hosted memory engine.
- [Browser primitives](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/sdk/guides/browser-primitives.md): This guide bypasses MemoryClient.
- [Writing a custom provider](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/sdk/guides/custom-provider.md): The provider interface is deliberately small.
- [Using the Hindsight backend](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/sdk/guides/hindsight-backend.md): HindsightProvider is the SDK's HTTP client for Hindsight, Vectorize's memory engine built around per-user memory banks with retain, recall, and reflect operations.
- [Using the llmwiki backends](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/sdk/guides/llmwiki-backend.md): @atomicmemory/llmwiki connects Open Source to llm-wiki-compiler (llmwiki), which compiles raw sources into an interlinked markdown wiki.
- [Using the Mem0 backend](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/sdk/guides/mem0-backend.md): Mem0Provider is the SDK's HTTP client for Mem0.
- [Node.js / server-side](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/sdk/guides/nodejs-server.md): Using the SDK server-side is supported, the package is ESM + CJS, has no browser-only code on its critical path, and the subpath storage primitives run anywhere Node does.
- [Swapping backends](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/sdk/guides/swapping-backends.md): The SDK's provider architecture makes the capability of swapping backends real; this guide covers the operational story.
- [SDK Overview](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/sdk/overview.md): A TypeScript client for memory and artifact storage, pluggable across backends.
- [SDK Quickstart](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/sdk/quickstart.md): Install, initialize, and make your first ingest and search, with MemoryClient wired to a running atomicmemory-core.

## CLI

- [Open Source CLI (npm)](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/cli.md): @atomicmemory/cli is the Node.js command line for direct self-hosted core

## Integrations

- [Claude Code](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/integrations/coding-agents/claude-code.md): The Claude Code plugin is discovered from the public Atomic Memory monorepo.
- [Claude Code Cloud](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/integrations/coding-agents/claude-code/cloud.md): Cloud deployment details for Claude Code are coming soon.
- [Claude Code Local](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/integrations/coding-agents/claude-code/local.md): Give Claude Code persistent, cross-session memory backed by Open Source.
- [Codex](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/integrations/coding-agents/codex.md): Atomic Memory integrates with Codex through the shared MCP server and a memory protocol skill that handles retrieval, durable writes, and handoff snapshots.
- [Codex Cloud](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/integrations/coding-agents/codex/cloud.md): Cloud deployment details for Codex are coming soon.
- [Codex Local](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/integrations/coding-agents/codex/local.md): Give Codex persistent, cross-session memory backed by Open Source.
- [Cursor](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/integrations/coding-agents/cursor.md): Atomic Memory supports Cursor today through a local MCP integration and Cursor
- [Cursor Cloud](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/integrations/coding-agents/cursor/cloud.md): Cursor Cloud deployment details are coming soon.
- [Cursor Local](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/integrations/coding-agents/cursor/local.md): Cursor support is available today as a manual local integration using the
- [Hermes Agent](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/integrations/coding-agents/hermes.md): Atomic Memory integrates with Hermes as a native Python memory provider.
- [Hermes Cloud](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/integrations/coding-agents/hermes/cloud.md): Cloud deployment details for Hermes are coming soon.
- [Hermes Local](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/integrations/coding-agents/hermes/local.md): Give Hermes Agent persistent, cross-session memory backed by Open Source.
- [OpenClaw](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/integrations/coding-agents/openclaw.md): Atomic Memory integrates with OpenClaw as a plugin and skill bundle backed by the same MCP server and SDK primitives used elsewhere in the platform.
- [OpenClaw Cloud](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/integrations/coding-agents/openclaw/cloud.md): Cloud deployment details for OpenClaw are coming soon.
- [OpenClaw Local](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/integrations/coding-agents/openclaw/local.md): Give OpenClaw persistent, cross-channel memory backed by Open Source.
- [LangChain (JS)](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/integrations/frameworks/langchain-js.md): Atomic Memory provides LangChain JS helpers and agent tools around an injected Atomic Memory SDK client.
- [LangChain (JS) Cloud](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/integrations/frameworks/langchain-js/cloud.md): Cloud deployment details for the LangChain adapter are coming soon.
- [LangChain (JS) Local](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/integrations/frameworks/langchain-js/local.md): Open Source support for LangChain JS exposes durable semantic memory through helper functions and LangChain-native tools.
- [Langflow](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/integrations/frameworks/langflow.md): Atomic Memory provides Langflow custom components that add durable semantic memory to visual AI workflows through the Python atomicmemory SDK.
- [Langflow Cloud](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/integrations/frameworks/langflow/cloud.md): Hosted Langflow setup is not documented yet.
- [Langflow Local](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/integrations/frameworks/langflow/local.md): Add durable, cross-session memory to Langflow flows with Atomic Memory custom components.
- [LangGraph (JS)](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/integrations/frameworks/langgraph-js.md): Atomic Memory provides LangGraph node factories that add durable retrieval and ingest beside graph-scoped checkpointers.
- [LangGraph (JS) Cloud](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/integrations/frameworks/langgraph-js/cloud.md): Cloud deployment details for the LangGraph adapter are coming soon.
- [LangGraph (JS) Local](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/integrations/frameworks/langgraph-js/local.md): Open Source support for LangGraph JS provides durable semantic memory next to LangGraph's run-scoped checkpointers.
- [Mastra](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/integrations/frameworks/mastra.md): Atomic Memory provides Mastra tools that map agent memory search and ingest onto Atomic Memory retrieval and ingest primitives.
- [Mastra Cloud](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/integrations/frameworks/mastra/cloud.md): Cloud deployment details for the Mastra adapter are coming soon.
- [Mastra Local](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/integrations/frameworks/mastra/local.md): Open Source support for Mastra exposes durable memory search and ingest as Mastra tools around your SDK MemoryClient.
- [OpenAI Agents SDK](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/integrations/frameworks/openai-agents.md): Atomic Memory integrates with the OpenAI Agents SDK through an adapter that augments run input with memory and ingests completed turns back into durable storage.
- [OpenAI Agents SDK Cloud](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/integrations/frameworks/openai-agents/cloud.md): Cloud deployment details for the OpenAI Agents SDK adapter are coming soon.
- [OpenAI Agents SDK Local](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/integrations/frameworks/openai-agents/local.md): Give OpenAI Agents SDK applications persistent memory backed by Open Source.
- [Vercel AI SDK](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/integrations/frameworks/vercel-ai-sdk.md): Atomic Memory integrates with Vercel AI SDK through an adapter that handles retrieval before the model call and durable ingest after the turn completes.
- [Vercel AI SDK Cloud](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/integrations/frameworks/vercel-ai-sdk/cloud.md): Cloud deployment details for the Vercel AI SDK adapter are coming soon.
- [Vercel AI SDK Local](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/integrations/frameworks/vercel-ai-sdk/local.md): Give Vercel AI SDK applications persistent memory backed by Open Source.
- [Integrations](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/integrations/overview.md): Atomic Memory adds durable memory to coding agents, AI frameworks, and terminal workflows through the same provider-backed memory layer.

## API Reference

- [AtomicMemory HTTP API](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/api-reference/http/atomicmemory-http-api.md): Semantic memory engine for AI applications.
- [Auto-resolve all expired conflicts for a user.](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/api-reference/http/auto-resolve-agent-conflicts.md): Auto-resolve all expired conflicts for a user.
- [Memory-cap status for a user's store.](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/api-reference/http/check-memory-cap.md): Memory-cap status for a user's store.
- [Compute consolidation candidates; optionally execute (execute=true).](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/api-reference/http/consolidate-memories.md): Compute consolidation candidates; optionally execute (execute=true).
- [Conventions](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/api-reference/http/conventions.md): General conventions that apply across every /v1/memories/ and /v1/agents/ route.
- [Deactivate a lesson by id.](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/api-reference/http/deactivate-lesson.md): Deactivate a lesson by id.
- [Delete one allowed disposable test scope.](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/api-reference/http/delete-admin-scope.md): Mounted only when CORE_ADMIN_API_KEY and CORE_TEST_SCOPE_ALLOW_PATTERN are both configured.
- [Soft-delete (tombstone) a document.](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/api-reference/http/delete-document.md): Idempotent: a second DELETE on the same id returns success with `already_deleted: true`.
- [Cascade-delete all data for an entity.](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/api-reference/http/delete-entity.md): Deletes memories, entity attributes, user profile, entity graph records, entity edges, and entity cards for the given entity ID.
- [Delete a single memory by UUID.](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/api-reference/http/delete-memory.md): Delete a single memory by UUID.
- [Soft-delete an artifact (optionally cascading documents).](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/api-reference/http/delete-storage-artifact.md): Reference-aware delete.
- [Evaluate decay candidates. dry_run=false archives them.](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/api-reference/http/evaluate-decay.md): Evaluate decay candidates.
- [Expand a list of memory IDs into full objects.](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/api-reference/http/expand-memories.md): Expand a list of memory IDs into full objects.
- [Look up the trust level for a (user, agent) pair.](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/api-reference/http/get-agent-trust.md): Look up the trust level for a (user, agent) pair.
- [Aggregate mutation statistics for a user's memory store.](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/api-reference/http/get-audit-summary.md): Aggregate mutation statistics for a user's memory store.
- [Wire capabilities descriptor for protocol-level callers.](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/api-reference/http/get-capabilities.md): Unauthenticated.
- [Fetch a single document by UUID.](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/api-reference/http/get-document.md): Fetch a single document by UUID.
- [Read upload + index byte caps and raw-storage capability.](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/api-reference/http/get-document-limits.md): Public preflight surface.
- [Get entity detail — attributes, relations, and recent cards.](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/api-reference/http/get-entity.md): Pass `?entity_name=<name>` to resolve entity relations for a specific named entity in the user's graph.
- [Get structured attribute triples for an entity.](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/api-reference/http/get-entity-attributes.md): Returns `(entity, attribute, value, type)` triples extracted from memories.
- [Get the synthesized profile for a user or agent.](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/api-reference/http/get-entity-profile.md): Returns the auto-synthesized prose profile from `user_profiles` plus top structured attribute triples from `entity_attributes`.
- [Lesson statistics for a user.](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/api-reference/http/get-lesson-stats.md): Lesson statistics for a user.
- [Fetch a single memory by UUID.](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/api-reference/http/get-memory.md): Fetch a single memory by UUID.
- [Per-memory version history.](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/api-reference/http/get-memory-audit-trail.md): Per-memory version history.
- [Fetch a single memory by caller-owned metadata.externalId.](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/api-reference/http/get-memory-by-external-id.md): Reverse lookup of a memory by its `metadata.externalId`, scoped to `user_id`.
- [Subsystem liveness + current runtime config snapshot.](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/api-reference/http/get-memory-health.md): Subsystem liveness + current runtime config snapshot.
- [Get the mutation history of a single memory record.](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/api-reference/http/get-memory-history.md): Surfaces the full AUDN version chain for a memory — ADD, UPDATE, SUPERSEDE events in chronological order.
- [Recent mutations for a user, limit-bounded.](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/api-reference/http/get-recent-audit.md): Recent mutations for a user, limit-bounded.
- [Get deferred-mutation reconciliation status.](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/api-reference/http/get-reconcile-status.md): Get deferred-mutation reconciliation status.
- [Aggregate memory statistics for a user.](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/api-reference/http/get-stats.md): Aggregate memory statistics for a user.
- [Read an artifact metadata projection.](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/api-reference/http/get-storage-artifact.md): Read an artifact metadata projection.
- [Read the raw bytes for a managed artifact.](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/api-reference/http/get-storage-artifact-content.md): Returns the artifact bytes for managed-mode artifacts.
- [Read the direct storage API capability snapshot.](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/api-reference/http/get-storage-capabilities.md): Public preflight surface for the storage API.
- [Chunk + embed text for a registered document.](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/api-reference/http/index-document.md): Deterministic char-window chunking, batched embeddings via the core embedding provider, and one provenance-linked memory per chunk.
- [Ingest a conversation transcript with full extraction.](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/api-reference/http/ingest-memory.md): Full-extraction ingest.
- [Quick ingest (storeVerbatim when skip_extraction=true).](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/api-reference/http/ingest-memory-quick.md): Quick or verbatim ingest.
- [List open agent conflicts for a user.](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/api-reference/http/list-agent-conflicts.md): List open agent conflicts for a user.
- [List active documents for a user, optionally filtered by source_site.](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/api-reference/http/list-documents.md): List active documents for a user, optionally filtered by source_site.
- [Cursor-paginated user-scoped document list with status-bucket filter.](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/api-reference/http/list-documents-for-user.md): Returns active documents for the supplied `user_id`, ordered `(created_at DESC, id DESC)`.
- [Documents WITHOUT non-deleted memories, narrowed by recovery-status filter.](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/api-reference/http/list-documents-without-memories.md): Backs the passport synthetic-row stream and the UI 'uploaded but unindexed' surface.
- [List all entities with memory counts.](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/api-reference/http/list-entities.md): Returns all distinct entity IDs for the authenticated deployment, ordered by most recently active.
- [List active lessons for a user.](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/api-reference/http/list-lessons.md): List active lessons for a user.
- [List memories for a user (or workspace).](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/api-reference/http/list-memories.md): List memories for a user (or workspace).
- [Memory-backed passport feed: grouped doc rows + standalone memories.](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/api-reference/http/list-passport-feed.md): Single SQL UNION ALL: one row per documentId-with-memories (grouped on `raw_document_id`, joined to `raw_documents` for the status envelope) plus 1:1 standalone-memory rows (memories whose `raw_document_id IS NULL`).
- [Mark the document as extraction-failed.](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/api-reference/http/mark-extraction-failure.md): Service-owned status transition: callers declare *that* extraction failed and *what category* via a bounded `error_code`.
- [Mark the document as index-failed.](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/api-reference/http/mark-index-failure.md): Service-owned status transition.
- [Merge a source entity into a target entity.](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/api-reference/http/merge-entities.md): Re-scopes all memories, attributes, cards, and graph edges from `source` to `target` in a single transaction, then deletes the source entity.
- [OpenAPI Spec](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/api-reference/http/openapi-spec.md): Download the canonical Open Source Core OpenAPI document:
- [Update per-entity extraction guidance and pipeline config.](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/api-reference/http/patch-entity-settings.md): Stores an extraction prompt (up to 1,500 chars) and pipeline overrides for a specific entity.
- [Register a pointer artifact or upload a managed artifact.](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/api-reference/http/put-storage-artifact.md): Pointer mode sends a JSON body with `mode: 'pointer'` plus a caller-supplied `uri`; the server stores the reference but NEVER fetches the URI.
- [Reconcile deferred mutations for a user (or all users when user_id is absent).](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/api-reference/http/reconcile-deferred.md): Reconcile deferred mutations for a user (or all users when user_id is absent).
- [Register a pointer-only document.](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/api-reference/http/register-document.md): Idempotent on (user_id, source_site, provider, external_id, provider_version).
- [Report a new lesson.](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/api-reference/http/report-lesson.md): Report a new lesson.
- [Delete all memories for a given user + source_site.](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/api-reference/http/reset-by-source.md): Delete all memories for a given user + source_site.
- [Resolve a specific conflict with one of the three enum variants.](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/api-reference/http/resolve-agent-conflict.md): Resolve a specific conflict with one of the three enum variants.
- [Full semantic search with optional temporal / retrieval-mode / token-budget controls.](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/api-reference/http/search-memories.md): Full semantic search with optional temporal / retrieval-mode / token-budget controls.
- [Latency-optimized search (skips LLM repair loop). ~88% lower latency than /search.](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/api-reference/http/search-memories-fast.md): Latency-optimized search (skips LLM repair loop).
- [Set the calling user's trust level for a given agent.](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/api-reference/http/set-agent-trust.md): Set the calling user's trust level for a given agent.
- [Mutate runtime config (dev/test only). 410 when disabled.](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/api-reference/http/update-config.md): Set CORE_RUNTIME_CONFIG_MUTATION_ENABLED=true to enable.
- [Upload managed raw bytes for a registered document.](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/api-reference/http/upload-raw-document.md): Stores the request body as the document's managed blob via the configured `RawContentStore` adapter (`local_fs` or `s3`), and promotes the document row to `storage_mode='managed_blob'` / `raw_storage_status='blob_stored'`.
- [Run the backend's verification (head-probe in v1).](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/api-reference/http/verify-storage-artifact.md): Pointer-mode artifacts always return `kind: 'unsupported'` — the server never fetches the registered URI.

## Other

- [Open Source vs Atomic Memory](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/cloud-vs-open-source.md): Atomic Memory runs in three modes backed by the same engine.
- [Authentication](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/cloud/authentication.md): Atomic Memory and Core each authenticate requests differently.
- [CLI](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/cloud/cli.md): The Atomic Memory CLI (atomicmemory / am) is the primary CLI for
- [Developer Console](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/cloud/console.md): The Atomic Memory developer console at memory.atomicstrata.ai is a Next.js dashboard for provisioning projects, managing API keys, exploring memories, and inspecting AUDN mutation traces.
- [Managing API Keys](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/cloud/how-to/api-keys.md): The API Keys page issues and manages the Atomic Memory credentials your application uses to authenticate against a Cloud project's memory API.
- [Reading the Audit Log](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/cloud/how-to/audit-log.md): The Audit Log records the administrative actions taken on a Cloud project - key, settings, and lifecycle changes - so you can see who changed what and when.
- [Plans & Billing](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/cloud/how-to/billing.md): Plans & Billing shows your Organization's current plan and tracks project and write-token usage against it.
- [Resolving Conflicts](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/cloud/how-to/conflicts.md): The Conflict queue is where an admin reviews competing beliefs the memory layer could not reconcile on its own and applies a resolution.
- [The Dashboard](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/cloud/how-to/dashboard.md): The Dashboard is a project's landing page - headline stats, copy-ready tool snippets, and recent activity in one view.
- [Migrate to Atomic Memory](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/cloud/how-to/migrate.md): Move memories from a Connected Local project into an Atomic Memory project with am migrate export and am migrate import.
- [Using the Playground](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/cloud/how-to/playground.md): The Playground lets you ingest memories and run searches against your project straight from the dashboard - no terminal, no client code.
- [Projects](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/cloud/how-to/projects.md): Projects are the isolated containers that hold your memories, API keys, and traces - Local (Connected Local, your own Core) or Cloud (Atomic Memory, fully managed).
- [Project Settings](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/cloud/how-to/settings.md): Project Settings is where you rename a project, see where its memory data lives, export it, manage the organization, and delete the project.
- [Understanding Traces](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/cloud/how-to/traces.md): The Traces page records what your memory layer did on every request - each retrieval, mutation, and package call, inspectable down to the memories and reasoning involved.
- [Usage & Limits](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/cloud/how-to/usage.md): The Usage page reports a project's request volumes, storage metrics, and cost drivers alongside your Organization's plan limits.
- [What is Memories](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/cloud/how-to/what-is-memories.md): The Memories page is where you inspect everything the memory layer has stored for a project - and why.
- [Overview](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/cloud/overview.md): Run memory on your own machine.
- [Add Atomic Memory](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/cloud/quickstart.md): Add Atomic Memory — managed memory hosting — after your local Core is
- [Troubleshooting](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/cloud/troubleshooting.md): Symptom, check, and recovery steps for the most common Connected Local activation and Cloud console problems.
- [Audit every memory mutation](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/cloud/use-cases/audit-every-mutation.md): Keep a complete, inspectable record of what changed in memory, when, and by which key - for compliance reviews and incident response.
- [Debug retrieval with traces](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/cloud/use-cases/debug-retrieval.md): When the model recalls the wrong thing, use retrieval traces and the Playground to see which memories a query returned and why.
- [Deletion & retention by scope](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/cloud/use-cases/deletion-and-retention.md): Honor deletion and right-to-be-forgotten requests precisely - remove one person's memory while shared team context stays intact.
- [Long-term memory across sessions](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/cloud/use-cases/long-term-memory.md): Give an AI assistant memory that persists across sessions, so it recalls each user without you standing up a datastore.
- [Monitor usage & limits](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/cloud/use-cases/monitor-usage-and-limits.md): See a project's consumption next to your plan limits in one view, so you catch growth before it turns into a surprise bill or a throttle.
- [One SDK, Local or Cloud](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/cloud/use-cases/one-sdk-self-hosted-or-managed.md): Use the same SDK and console whether your project is Local (your own Core) or Cloud (fully managed), so you can start Local and move to Cloud with no rewrite.
- [Per-user personalization with scopes](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/cloud/use-cases/per-user-personalization.md): Isolate every end-user's memory with a per-user scope, so one app serves many users without their context bleeding together.
- [Store preferences without a database](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/cloud/use-cases/preferences-without-a-database.md): Capture durable user preferences through ingest and search - reconciled writes keep one standing fact per preference, so you never design a schema or run a database.
- [Prototype in the Playground](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/cloud/use-cases/prototype-in-the-playground.md): Run ingest and search interactively from the dashboard and see the results - traces and stored memories - before you wire a single line of SDK code.
- [Reconcile facts instead of appending](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/cloud/use-cases/reconcile-facts.md): Every write resolves to an Add, Update, Delete, or No-op decision so memory stays consistent as facts change - and real conflicts surface instead of silently merging.
- [Least-privilege scoped API keys](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/cloud/use-cases/scoped-api-keys.md): Give each service a per-project, revocable API key so it reaches only the memory it needs - and every write stays attributable.
- [See what's stored - and why](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/cloud/use-cases/see-whats-stored.md): Inspect the reconciled memory state and the trace behind every fact, so you always know what your assistant has stored and why.
- [Share a read-only memory view](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/cloud/use-cases/share-a-read-only-view.md): Give a teammate or stakeholder a locked, read-only view of a project's memories - no account, no console access, and no way to change anything.
- [Core-only Docker](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/core-only-docker.md): Run Core on your machine with Docker and HTTP — no Cloud account,
- [Introduction](https://docs.atomicstrata.ai/introduction.md): Run memory locally in one command: the Quickstart installs
